title: Assignment 4 - Cantilever Beam Stress and Deflection
method: Euler-Bernoulli cantilever beam with an end point load
text: A cantilever beam carries a downward point load at its free end. Report the maximum bending stress in megapascals and the maximum free-end deflection in millimetres.

assumptions.cross_section: prismatic rectangular section along the full length
assumptions.load_case: single static point load at the free end

requirements.text: Calculate the maximum bending stress in the beam and report it in megapascals.
Calculate the maximum free-end deflection and report it in millimetres.

deliverables: A single PDF report showing the method, the numeric substitution, and the final values.
